title: Exactness after restriction to a union of opens
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $K$ a cochain complex of $\mathcal O_X$-module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $(V_i)_{i\in I}$ be any family of open subsets, $U=\bigcup_i V_i$, and $n\in\mathbf Z$. If the termwise restriction of $K$ to every $V_i$ is exact in degree $n$, then its termwise restriction to $U$ is exact in degree $n$.

proof.text: Set S = K.sc n, the short complex of consecutive differentials. Open restriction is additive and preserves finite limits and finite colimits, by the already proved moduleOverFunctor instances exported by Sheaf.Paper.DerivedHomMayerVietoris. Mathlib ShortComplex.LeftHomologyData.exact_map_iff therefore identifies exactness of S restricted to any open W with vanishing of the restriction of S.leftHomologyData.H. The short complex of the termwise restricted complex is definitionally S.map of the restriction functor.

Prove vanishing on the union directly from the sheaf axiom. For any object W→U of the over-site and section x over W, the opens W∩V_i cover W: a point of W lies in U and hence in some V_i by hU. Evaluate the zero sheaf H restricted to V_i on W∩V_i→V_i. Its section module is subsingleton, so the restrictions of x and zero agree. Mathlib TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' then gives x=0. Thus the identity endomorphism of H restricted to U is zero. The argument permits an empty index type; the covering condition then forces every W→U to have empty underlying open.

Apply step 1 to each exactness hypothesis to obtain vanishing of the restricted left homology object on V_i. Apply step 2 to this homology object, and apply step 1 in the reverse direction for U. This proves ExactAt n without any new unproved statement.

proof_origin.note: Complete Lean proof: reduce to vanishing of left homology using Mathlib exact_map_iff, then use sheaf separation on intersections with the covering opens. No stalk theory or new sorry is used.

mathlib_searches.query: Exactness of sheaf complexes is local on an open covering
Exactness of a complex of sheaves of modules can be checked on an open cover

from.place: Perfect-generation induction: Koszul complexes vanish on the basic-open complement

lean.statement:
theorem exactAt_over_of_open_cover
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (K : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (ι : Type v) (V : ι → X.Opens) (U : X.Opens) (hU : U = ⨆ i, V i)
    (n : ℤ)
    (h : ∀ i, (((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (V i)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K).ExactAt n) :
    (((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K).ExactAt n
